name: Amazon Quick Suite
name_zh: Amazon Quick Suite 智能工作台
desc: AWS agentic workspace for business users
desc_zh: 面向业务人员的 AWS 智能体工作台
solves: A business question rarely lives in one tool. Quick connects Slack, Jira, Salesforce and Microsoft 365, and non-engineers can build the intake form or tracker themselves.
solves_zh: 一个业务问题很少只落在一个工具里。Quick 接上 Slack、Jira、Salesforce 和 Microsoft 365，非工程岗也能自己搭表单。
best_for: When the answer needs numbers from several SaaS tools and the person asking does not write code.
best_for_zh: 当答案要横跨几个 SaaS 工具，而提问的人不写代码。
notes: Bundles structured BI data with Microsoft 365, Jira and Salesforce, which is the specific gap Bedrock and Amazon Q leave open. 来源：https://www.computerworld.com/article/3967788/aws-new-ai-agentic-platform-aims-to-automate-business-workflows.html
